content.text:
Scrolling between the latest task and Previous tasks now slides, as the spec's "Scrolling Past" section describes. I haven't watched it in the app, only in tests, so I don't know yet how it looks and feels.

- **Scrolling up** past the top of the latest task, Previous tasks slide down from above, already on the most recent tasks. They push the latest task's header and output down and out as one column.
- **Scrolling down** past the bottom of Previous tasks, the latest task's header and output slide up from below, starting at their top. They push Previous tasks up and out.
